visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white lacy dress, stands in an outdoor park with wooden benches and trees, holding multiple colorful snack bags. (2) She attempts to throw the snacks into the air for a trick, but they all fall onto the wooden table and ground. She looks at the camera with a disappointed expression. (3) The camera follows her as she walks toward the entrance of the Houli Horse Park, gesturing with her arms to showcase the gate and circus signs. (4) Inside a large circus tent, various performers are shown in a montage: an aerialist performing on silks, the woman interacting with a large gorilla mascot, and acrobats performing on a rotating 'death wheel' and inside a motorcycle 'globe of death'. (5) The woman is seen riding a small park shuttle train, looking back at the camera and talking while moving through the park. (6) She changes into a black equestrian outfit with a helmet and boots, petting a large white horse in a stable area. (7) Finally, she is shown riding the white horse in a professional arena, waving to the camera and flashing a peace sign while being guided by an instructor.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, several circus performers, audience members in background, and 1 riding instructor.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with long black hair, fair skin, initially wearing a revealing white lacy sleeveless dress, then changing into a professional black equestrian shirt, riding pants, and a black helmet.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Outdoor park with wooden tables and trees; interior of a large circus tent with red curtains and spotlights; an equestrian arena with sand footing and grandstands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy upbeat electronic music starts immediately. A female voice speaks excitedly to a cameraman. Minimal outdoor background air. (2) Soft rustling of snack bags followed by multiple light thuds as they hit a wooden surface. A male voice laughs mockingly. (3) A synthesized whoosh transition sound occurs as the location changes. The female voice introduces the circus with a more project, narrative tone. (4) The acoustic environment shifts to a cavernous indoor space with noticeable reverb. Sounds of a crowd applauding and distant mechanical whirring from circus equipment are audible. (5) Mechanical hum of a small electric engine and wheel rolling on tracks is heard as the woman rides the shuttle. (6) Sounds of horse hooves crunching on sand and occasional soft snorting from a horse. The female voice becomes more focused and informative while discussing riding lessons.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the tourist attractions and equestrian services at Houli Horse Park in Taichung, focusing on the circus show and riding lessons.
